Also 'omega 1316/158' or 'omega ladies 566.0xxx cosmic'. Auction results: Noble Numismatics, Leski, Theodore Bruce, Mossgreen archive and LiveAuctioneers for 'Omega Seamaster Cosmic ladies'. Pens: eBay sold 'Parker 51 grey lustraloy fountain pen' and 'Parker 51 aerometric cap steel' (nib size and condition; a plain steel-cap 51 is usually modest).
viewing_check: Wind the crown and shake: does the seconds/rotor run and does the date change? Open the case back if allowed: ref (e.g. 566.xxx/ 551.xxx) and calibre (cal. 681/684). Check crystal, dial spotting, bracelet stretch and clasp. Pens: cap imprint (PARKER 51 vs 21), nib marks (14K = 51), cracks in barrel or hood, filler working. Necklace: look for 925 mark.
